data.name: Quraisha
data.gender_notes: Quraisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Quraisha is an Arabic name derived from the word 'quraysh' (قريش), which means a young she-camel. In Islamic tradition, Quraisha is the name of the tribe to which the Prophet Muhammad belonged. The name Quraisha carries the meaning “Young She-camel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Quraisha usually hope their child will grow to embody young she-camel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace your noble lineage and live with compassion and strength.
data.etymology: Quraisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young She-camel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quraisha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: قرعيشة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني النجوم، والمجموعة الكوكبية، والعصا، والمعجون
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قرعيشة يأتي من الجذر القريب من النجوم والمجموعة الكوكبية، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الأجرام السماوية، ويعد من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويختلف في تفسيره بين العلماء، ويُعتبر اسمًا شائعًا بين المسلمين، ويحمل روحًا من الحكمة والخير، ويُعتبر اسمًا مناسبًا للفتيات المولودات في شهر رمضان المبارك، ويعزز من الشخصية القوية والشجاعة والصبر والطاعة.

in_urdu.long_meaning: قرعیشہ نام کا تعلق بھیڑ کے نام سے ہے، جس کے معنی بنتارہ بھیڑ ہیں، اور یہ اسماء اللہ کے ناموں میں شمار ہوتا ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے، اور اس کے معنی پر مختلف تفسیر کی گئی ہے، لیکن اسے کریم اور شاندار سمجھا جاتا ہے، یہ نام رمضان المبارک میں پیدائش کے موقع پر بھی مناسب ہوتا ہے، اور اس سے عورتوں میں شجاعت و صبر کی خواص پائی جاتی ہیں

in_english.name: Quraisha
in_english.meaning: Name meaning stars, a group of stars, and a stick or paste
in_english.long_meaning: The name Quraisha originates from the Arabic root for stars and a group of stars, and is used in the Quran to refer to celestial bodies. It is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and has different interpretations among scholars. It is a popular name among Muslims, and is considered a name that evokes wisdom and goodness. It is suitable for girls born in the month of Ramadan, and enhances the personality of strong and courageous women who are patient and obedient.

data.cultural_impact: Quraisha is a name deeply rooted in Islamic history as it refers to the tribe of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Being part of this tribe afforded the Prophet a unique place in the Arabian Peninsula, allowing him to build a community that would spread the message of Islam to the world. The name has a great significance in Islamic heritage as Quraishis were named after their ancient forefathers, who were idol worshippers. The Prophet, through his Message of Islam, led the Quraishis and many others to embrace Monotheism (Tawheed), changing the course of history. Additionally, Al-Masjid Al-Haram, the holiest site in Islam, is located in the city of Mecca, which was a part of the Quraish dominion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Quraisha contains spiritual significance as it marks the Prophet's ancestry and ties him to the sacred city of Mecca. Several historical events in the Prophet's life were centered around the Quraish tribe, including the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and the Battle of Tabuk. The name carries the legacy of the Prophet's mission to spread the message of Islam and thereby offers a connection to the spiritual journey of the community and the world at large. The name reminds us of the transformative power of faith, as exhibited through the evolution of the Quraishis from a tribe of idol worshippers to a community of believers.
